test.create_query: CREATE TABLE sort_string_prefix_keys ( random String, url String, value String, low_cardinality String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO sort_string_prefix_keys SELECT randomPrintableASCII(8 + rand() % 25), concat('https://www.example.com/', ['news', 'sport', 'shop', 'blog'][1 + rand(1) % 4], '/', toString(rand(2) % 100000), '?id=', toString(rand(3))), concat('value_', toString(rand(4) % 1000)), toString(rand(5) % 50) FROM numbers(5000000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE sort_string_prefix_keys_arrays ( arr Array(String), arr_url Array(String), m Map(String, UInt64) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO sort_string_prefix_keys_arrays SELECT arrayMap(j -> randomPrintableASCII(8 + rand(j) % 25), range(100)), arrayMap(j -> concat('https://www.example.com/', toString(rand(j) % 100000)), range(100)), mapFromArrays(arrayMap(j -> concat(randomPrintableASCII(8), toString(j)), range(100)), range(100)) FROM numbers(100000)
